title: Test-Time Confidence Adaptation under RL-Induced Trajectory Shift
title_zh: RL诱导轨迹偏移下的测试时置信度自适应

paragraphs.en: 发现轨迹稳定性与正确性的关系在RL后保持不变，据此提出无需标注的StaR-TTA置信度自适应框架。 Trajectory-based confidence estimation has shown promising performance for large language models (LLMs) by leveraging rich signals from their reasoning processes. However, we find that such confidence estimators can degrade substantially after agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) as it induces substantial shifts in the reasoning trajectories. More importantly, despite these shifts, we uncover a reliability structure that is largely preserved across Base and RL models: $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{stable}$ $\textbf{trajectories}$ $\textbf{remain}$ $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{likely}$ $\textbf{to}$ $\textbf{produce}$ $\textbf{correct}$ $\textbf{answers}$. This preserved relationship provides a transferable, label-free reliability signal for post-RL confidence adaptation. Building on this finding, we propose $\textbf{StaR-TTA}$, a stability-guided framework for label-free test-time confidence adaptation. StaR-TTA jointly learns from correctness supervision and stability-derived reliability supervision on labeled Base trajectories, establishing the connection between trajectory stability and answer reliability. At test time, it reuses stability-induced reliability rankings from unlabeled RL trajectories to adapt confidence scores to the shifted trajectory distribution, without requiring target correctness labels. Across four QA benchmarks, StaR-TTA achieves an average AUROC of \(0.721\), with consistent improvements across unseen datasets, model families and scales, and different Agentic RL algorithms.
paragraphs.zh: 发现轨迹稳定性与正确性的关系在RL后保持不变，据此提出无需标注的StaR-TTA置信度自适应框架。基于轨迹的置信度估计通过利用大语言模型（LLMs）推理过程中的丰富信号，已展现出可观的性能。 然而，我们发现这类置信度估计器在智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）之后会显著退化，因为智能体强化学习会导致推理轨迹发生大幅偏移。 更重要的是，尽管存在这些偏移，我们揭示了一种在Base模型与RL模型之间基本得以保留的可靠性结构：$\textbf{更}$ $\textbf{稳定}$ $\textbf{的}$ $\textbf{轨迹}$ $\textbf{仍}$ $\textbf{更}$ $\textbf{有}$ $\textbf{可能}$ $\textbf{产生}$ $\textbf{正确}$ $\textbf{答案}$。 这一被保留的关系为RL后置阶段的置信度自适应提供了一种可迁移的、无需标注的可靠性信号。 基于这一发现，我们提出了 $\textbf{StaR-TTA}$，一个以稳定性为引导的、无需标注的测试时置信度自适应框架。 StaR-TTA 在有标注的 Base 轨迹上联合学习正确性监督与由稳定性导出的可靠性监督，从而建立轨迹稳定性与答案可靠性之间的联系。 在测试时，它复用来自无标注 RL 轨迹的稳定性诱导的可靠性排序，使置信度分数适应发生偏移的轨迹分布，而无需目标正确性标签。 在四个问答基准上，StaR-TTA 取得了 \(0.721\) 的平均 AUROC，并在未见过的数据集、不同模型家族与规模、以及不同智能体强化学习算法上均取得一致的提升。
